title: Samsung 25R 18650 Battery
description:
Samsung 25R is a high-quality 18650 lithium-ion battery designed for high-output applications like powering Box Mod vape devices. Samsung 25R 18650 batteries are rated for 300 full charge cycles, provide 2500mAh battery capacity, and deliver 20 amps of continuous power.

The price includes one battery. Ensure the purchase of two batteries if required for the intended device.

Samsung 25R 18650 Battery Features:

- Standard capacity: 2500mAh

- Minimum capacity: 2450mAh

- Max continuous current: 20 Amp

- Nominal output voltage: 3.6V

- Charge input voltage: 4.2V

- Standard charge time: 3 hours

- Fast charge time: 1 hour

- Rated charge cycles: 300

- Weight: 43.8g – 45g

- Dimensions: 64.85mm x 18.33mm

- Chemistry: (NCA) Lithium Nickel Cobalt Aluminum Oxide

- Type: 18650

Includes:
1 X Samsung 25R 18650 Battery 2500mAh
